actionable_sentences: The AddAgenda API must be invoked with a valid token obtained from GetUserToken, along with the agenda content, time in YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS format, and location.
All four parameters (token, content, time, location) are required for the AddAgenda API call and must be present in the request.
lifted_nl: The AddAgenda API must be invoked with a valid token obtained from GetUserToken, along with agenda content, a time value in YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS format, and a location.
For the AddAgenda API call, the token, content, time, and location parameters must all be present in the request.
The API name 'AddAgenda' must match case-insensitively against the evaluator's expected name.
operations.LABEL: FUNCTIONAL_SPEC
operations.Precondition: A valid token string is available from GetUserToken, and all three additional parameters (content, time, location) are non-empty strings meeting the required format specifications.
operations.Function: add_agenda(token: str, content: str, time: str, location: str) -> dict
operations.Postcondition: The agenda was successfully added to the system with the specified content, time, and location; the response contains a status indicating success.
assumptions: The user has already obtained a valid token via GetUserToken and possesses it in the session.
The time string conforms to the YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS format.
The location string is a non-empty descriptive text.
invariants: After the AddAgenda call completes, the stored agenda record retains the original content, time, and location values without modification.
The token used for the call remains valid and associated with the requesting user.
